part_1.situation:
Our Community Centre

Dear Members

I'm writing to ask for your feedback on the facilities at our community centre. We'd love to hear about the things you like, but as we have some money to spend, please tell us about any facilities you think could be improved. Also, are there any new facilities you think the centre could offer?

Thanks for your help with this.

Jo Lloyd (Manager)
part_1.instruction: You've seen this notice at the community centre in your neighbourhood. Write an email to the manager giving your opinion.
points_to_include: a suggestion for a new facility

part_1.situation:
A Restaurant for the Staff?

Several people have asked me whether it would be possible to have a staff restaurant. A number of reasons have been given in support of this idea, but I'd like to hear from as many of you as possible with your views. Please email me as soon as possible.

Thanks

Mike

General Manager
part_1.instruction: You've seen this notice on the staff noticeboard where you work. Write an email to the manager giving your own opinion.
points_to_include: whether you would use the restaurant
how staff would benefit from it
what the manager should do next

part_2.instruction: Write an email to a friend about your first day in a new job. Describe what happened and how you feel about the job.

part_2.title: The Lost Notebook
part_2.instruction: Write a short story for a magazine, with the title 'The Lost Notebook'. Describe what happened and how the person felt during the experience.
